title: Inspectorate referral body
description: The inspectorate refers a finding to the Courts (register row DK1744; spec-delta S1605): `finding` is an inspectorate_finding in this log, `custody_case` optionally the case whose chain of custody holds the evidence (it must have at least one item), `summary` says what the Courts are asked to review. Signed by the inspectorate (referral_wrong_issuer); one referral for each finding (referral_known). A referral reports and asks for review: it slashes, strikes or quarantines nothing, and the agent may answer in the Courts. Chain: none (prev is null).
